name: Drug Use
overview: Scripture warns against the deceptive and harmful effects of substances like strong drink, highlighting the sorrow, conflict, and physical consequences they bring (Proverbs 20:1; 23:29). Believers are called to present their bodies as living sacrifices, holy and acceptable to God, avoiding behaviors such as drunkenness and rioting that dishonor God (Romans 12:1; 13:13). Instead, Christians are urged to renew their minds and resist conformity to worldly patterns, seeking what pleases God and truly satisfies the soul rather than spending on things that do not nourish (Romans 12:2; Isaiah 55:2).
